title: Restricted width tail bound for a term
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $T$ be a conjunction of signed literals on $n$ coordinates with pairwise distinct indices, and let $w$ be a natural number. Under the product distribution on coordinate restrictions that gives probability $1/2$ to leaving a coordinate free and probability $1/4$ to each of fixing it to $1$ or to $-1$, the probability that the restricted width of $T$ is at least $w$ is at most $(3/4)^w$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a DNF term with pairwise distinct literal coordinates
